---
description: "Frontend/web development guidance"
applyTo: "**/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx,css,scss,html}"
---

- Prefer accessible HTML (labels, aria where appropriate).
- Avoid inline styles unless that’s the project convention.
- Keep components small; refactor repeated UI into reusable components.
- When changing UI behavior, update/maintain any relevant tests if they exist.
- After edits, fix `#problems` top-to-bottom.
